CanEquip raw wrap, learned SDT_EQUIP kind, slot/class/level checks; CanPush simulates complete displaced capacity; special-equipment combat flag remains an open dependency.
Raw equality/copy and raw full-DWORD CanUse; GetEquipLevel compares full ELD before subtracting BYTE, retaining requirement if ELD is at least default level.

implementation.production: OnMoveItemReq -> PlanEquipmentMove -> PostgreSQLMapService::MoveInventoryItems/ValidateInventoryMove -> existing fresh item or authoritative graph writes -> committed derived snapshot -> original item/EQUIP/stat/HPMP packets.
implementation.schema: 032 adds append-only equipment_operations header and equipment_item_changes final per-identity diff. Header preserves five request bytes, owner/generation/epoch, state contract, graph/core hashes. Zero-diff operations and new/deleted IDs are explicit. Existing 027/028 receipts and applied migrations remain unchanged.
implementation.atomicity: Native process/account/session/authority/checkpoint locks enclose complete fresh item fingerprint/membership and rank validation or full graph comparison, pinned bags/rules, displacement/splits/swaps, shared identity high-water, rederived/clamped HP/MP, sampled skill timers, graph/recovery and all operation receipts. Late failures roll back items, resource changes, allocator and audit together.
implementation.source_rules: Raw wrap DWORD, learned SDT_EQUIP kind regardless of rank, slot then class then original level/ELD. Equipment bag is recovered template2/type0/19 slots; ordinary bags are type11. Two-hand secondary request remaps primary; displaced stacks merge before taking a blank and cannot use a not-yet-vacated source slot.
implementation.response: Original DEL/ADD/UPDATE displacement and main move order; complete EQUIP; MOVEITEM success; independently source-derived 87-byte statistics; 21-byte HPMP; final MOVEITEM success. Every response follows commit. Self and same Map/channel 3x3 local cells receive EQUIP; full cross-Map/multi-character acceptance pending.
implementation.derivation: Database reprojects raw items from the verified charts and recomputes character sheet, equipment skill permissions, weapon eligibility and attack timing. Unequip clamps HP/MP in the same commit; reequip does not heal. Inactive account pet inventory is not an active companion effect and is preserved.
implementation.recovery: Actual disconnect during delayed commit retains new equipment through final save and a fresh Login. Graph mutations remain authoritative over stale normalized rows; native backend process replacement and actual two-Map round trip preserve complete graphs, allocated IDs and timers. Existing daemon SIGKILL/SIGTERM/World/DB fault matrix is rerun.
implementation.unknown_commit: No automatic retry or stale save; handler marks persistence uncertain, closes without success and retains ownership for recovery. A lost COMMIT-response proxy specific to equipment was not injected; late rollback and disconnect during confirmed commit were exercised.
corrections: Atomic DB writes and reply-after-commit replace original deferred persistence and process-local ID allocation.
Remap alias to the same item is rejected as SAMEPOS; overlapping displacement is refused instead of reproducing pointer alias/double-free behavior.
Existing pinned bag-capacity bounds remain enforced instead of allowing invisible slots.
